entries.zh: 捲；卷起、裹起（捲袖、缠裹义）
entries.en: to roll up; to wrap (as rolling up sleeves, coiling)
to roll up the sleeves of a garment

entries.zh: 捲起：卷起（西语词头承上省略）
entries.en: to roll up
entries.notes: 词头末尾 '-' 为承前省略，义由汉字'捲起'与音写确定。

entries.en: to roll upward
to roll downward
to wrap; to bundle up

entries.zh: 包裹：包起来（作名词亦指包裹之物）
entries.en: to wrap up; a wrapped bundle/parcel

entries.zh: 包藏：包而藏之；怀藏（含隐匿义）
entries.en: to wrap and conceal; to harbor (within)
to wrap and bind; to tie up in a bundle
hulled (clean) rice

entries.zh: 米粽：米裹叶而煮成的粽子
entries.en: rice dumpling wrapped in leaves (rice cake/zongzi)

entries.zh: 米粒大：米粒之大（大粒米）
entries.en: large-grained rice; big rice grain
unpolished/coarse rice (with husk remnants)
entries.notes: 单字'糙'承米类语境，对应西语 arroç sucio。

entries.en: coarse/unhulled rice (grança, popilas)
unhusked grain (paddy, rice still in husk)
standing rice plant; rice in the field
young rice seedling/sprout

entries.zh: 稗：炒过的或落在晒场（晒台）上的稻粒；稗/粺字形存疑
entries.en: parched rice grains, or rice fallen on the drying floor
entries.notes: 封存件标注 [疑:稗/粺]，且 M/R 音写对应不齐，字义存疑降中。

entries.zh: 稻：未结实成熟前抽穗之稻
entries.en: rice in ear before grain forms; paddy plant
a sheaf/bundle of rice stalks

entries.zh: 稻範：稻堆（堆成堆之稻）；'範'字录写待核
entries.en: a heap/pile of rice (cooked or harvested)
entries.notes: '範'字与'堆/囤'义不合，字形或为原文摹写之误，西语 monton 提示'堆'义，降中。

entries.zh: 稻種：留作播种之糙稻种
entries.en: unpolished rice kept for seed (sowing)
